RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Duelist Riposte
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Momentary Guard. Shortens the guard window from 2 seconds to 1, but Riposte deals 16 base ability damage to its selected target. One block, a 4-second riposte opportunity and fixed 12-second recovery remain. Choose this or Bulwark Stance in the build panel.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Bulwark Stance
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Momentary Guard. Riposte hits the selected target first and up to two other enemies within 2 cells of the caster, for 6 base ability damage each. Damaged survivors move 25% slower for 2 seconds. Walls block it. Keeps the 2-second guard window; mutually exclusive with Duelist Riposte.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Shrapnel Field
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Prismatic Mines. New mines trigger within 1 cell instead of 1.5. Their blast still reaches 2 cells and up to four enemies, now for 14 extra base damage each. Warning, deployment recovery and limits are unchanged. Mutually exclusive with Tripwire Field.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Tripwire Field
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Prismatic Mines. The oldest two armed mines form a tripwire when within 6 cells with clear sight; a third waits in reserve. An enemy within 0.7 cells of the segment starts a half-second warning. Both ends are consumed, dealing 5 extra base damage to up to four enemies still on the wire and slowing damaged survivors by 25% for 3 seconds. Moving away avoids it. Unpaired mines only detonate manually, within 2 cells for the same damage and slow. Mutually exclusive with Shrapnel Field.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Guarded Recovery
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Momentary Guard. A riposte that deals actual damage grants 4 base shield for 3 seconds. An area riposte grants this once, regardless of targets hit.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Covering Guard
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Momentary Guard. A successful guard grants 4 base shield for 3 seconds to the nearest eligible humanlike colonist within 4 cells and clear sight. Excludes the caster; does nothing without an eligible ally.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Exploit the Opening
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Momentary Guard. A riposte that damages its selected enemy marks an opening for 3 seconds. Your next basic hit on that enemy consumes it for 4 extra base damage. Holds one target only; secondary damage cannot consume or repeat it.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Smoldering Mechanism
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Prismatic Mines. A mine that deals actual damage burns surviving targets for 1 base damage each second, four times. Uses existing burn refresh rules, without separate stacking burn entries or additional detonations.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Recovered Ammunition
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Prismatic Mines and Prismatic Magazine. A detonation dealing actual damage restores one round to a non-full magazine, at most once per owner every 6 seconds. Multiple targets and paired tripwires still grant one round. Does not reset normal reload timing.

RimHex.HexAugmentDef.label: Reposition the Field
RimHex.HexAugmentDef.description: Requires Prismatic Mines and a learned Spin, Blink, Hunt or Swap movement ability. Actually moving with one of these skills extends your next deployment to 16 cells for 3 seconds, at most once every 8 seconds. Consumed by one deployment; does not reset deployment recovery or grant movement skills.
